ideas.idea: Pre-render or enable SSR so server HTML contains content (remove ssr:false)
ideas.why: This is the known ssr:false problem, already graded separately, so it should not be counted as a new idea.

ideas.idea: Make the robots.txt Sitemap line an absolute URL
ideas.why: This duplicates the known relative-Sitemap problem.

ideas.idea: Replace the button with NuxtLink to /guides
ideas.why: This duplicates the known button/router.push problem.
This duplicates the known noindex-on-/guides problem.

ideas.idea: List actual routes as text on the guides page, ideally one page each with its own URL
ideas.why: guides.vue only promises routes without listing any, so adding crawlable per-route pages gives real content to index and quote.

ideas.idea: Add a short text description and onward links to the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and one button, so descriptive text and links would help visitors and machines understand the site.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description via useHead/useSeoMeta
ideas.why: This duplicates the known single-title/description problem.

ideas.idea: Declare the real site origin and add an absolute canonical link per page
ideas.why: No canonical or site URL exists anywhere in the config, and the sitemap uses the placeholder trailhead.example, so declaring the origin enables correct canonicals.
